title: Starting my doctorate at the University of Bonn
text: In October 2026 I started my doctorate — a Doctor of Agricultural Sciences (Dr. agr.) at the University of Bonn, supervised by Prof. Dr. Frank Ewert. The research itself is carried out at the Leibniz Centre for Agricultural Landscape Research (ZALF) in Müncheberg, Germany.

title: Starting my doctorate at the University of Bonn
text:
Research focus
Landscape-scale agroecosystem modelling: spatial and temporal landscape dynamics, crop productivity and resilience.

title: Starting my doctorate at the University of Bonn
section: The question I am working on
text:
The question I am working on

How can spatial and temporal landscape information be represented and integrated into agroecosystem models to improve the understanding and prediction of crop productivity and resilience across scales?

I will share updates, code and results here as the project develops.

title: Krishnagopal Halder.
text:
Research experience




  
    2025
    
      Research Scientist
      
        Leibniz Centre for Agricultural Landscape Research (ZALF) · Müncheberg, Brandenburg, Germany · Jan 2025 – Present
      
      
      
        
        Research Platform <em>Simulation and Data Science</em>, Working Group <em>Multi-Scale Modelling and Forecasting (MSM)</em>, contributing to the Leibniz-Lab Systemic Sustainability (LL SYSTAIN) project.Developing machine learning workflows for <strong>multi-scale crop yield forecasting</strong> and scenario analysis integrating climate, soil and biodiversity indicators.Applying geospatial data science to process and harmonise large Earth observation and agricultural datasets (Sentinel, MODIS, soil grids).Co-designing sustainability indicators linking agricultural productivity and ecological resilience with interdisciplinary teams.
      
      
      
      Website
      
    
  

  
    2023
    
      Remote Intern
      
        Institute of Crop Science and Resource Conservation (INRES) · University of Bonn, Germany · Feb 2023 – Feb 2024
      
      
      
        
        Developed and validated ML/DL models (XGBoost, CNNs) for <strong>regional and continental-scale crop yield prediction</strong> from satellite-derived vegetation indices and climate data.Extracted phenological and climate features with Google Earth Engine, Python (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn) and TensorFlow for time-series analysis.Processed multi-terabyte Earth observation datasets on cloud computing platforms to derive agricultural insights and optimise model input features.Authored technical reports and visualised results (Matplotlib, Plotly), contributing to publications on data-driven agricultural sustainability.
